topic: Time is brain: 1.9 million neurons and 14 billion synapses lost per minute of untreated large-vessel ischemic stroke; brain ages 3.6 years per hour
question: Would you know the signs? 1 = yes, 2 = not sure
first_comment: Would you know the signs of a stroke? 1 = yes, 2 = not sure. I'll post my own answer with the reason tonight.
evening_answer_to_post_at_18_08: My answer: 1, yes. F.A.S.T. = Face drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty, Time to call for help. One true fact: in a typical untreated big-artery stroke, the brain loses about 1.9 million neurons every minute (Saver, Stroke 2006).
